fixtures.purpose: Reject Unicode/case-normalized path collisions before extraction.
Reject traversal, absolute, drive/device and trailing-dot/space paths.
Reject symlink/special entries and nested archives.
Bound entry count, compressed/expanded bytes and expansion ratio before allocation.
Reject duplicate canonical IDs and unknown required features.
Bound canonical tree depth, nodes, strings and records.
Reject durable capability/host/engine/session authority fields recursively.
Reject package identity, revision, digest and size substitution against exact locks.
Reject dependency cycles, missing nodes, excessive depth/count/bytes.
Deny raw JavaScript/Godot/PCK/GDExtension/process/filesystem/socket APIs on every target.
Prove signatures/provenance cannot create runtime authority.
Prove containment does not inherit parent capability.
Reject widened delegation scope/lifetime and bound delegation depth/count.
Treat forged cyclic grant ancestry as invalid/non-live without unbounded recursion.
Re-check live grant immediately before host invocation so revocation wins.
Bound per-principal service requests.
Allow only explicit validated trusted-proxy principal changes.
Contain recursive instruction and allocation amplification.
Contain event/timer/queue storms and reject unknown IR host opcodes.
Reject invalid exact-lock/dependency input before migration executes.
Forbid migration host/service access and bound migration cost/output.
Reject nested remote capability/host-authority injection.
Reject forged sender, cross-world/room and stale authority epochs.
Bound network bytes/tree/rate/queue independent of transport.
Make web/native/headless TCB differences explicit while keeping raw host denial invariant.
Reject incomplete protected AssetId revision bundle atomically.
Bound media compressed/decoded/pixel/audio sizes before decoder invocation.
Keep residual decoder/process/origin/cryptographic assurance explicit rather than claim sandbox proof.

observed_repairs.finding: Archive normalization must reject Unicode/case/native-device collisions before extraction.
observed_repairs.contract_effect: clarifies SEC-008/B1; no semantic identity change

observed_repairs.finding: Forbidden durable/network authority fields must be rejected recursively, not only at a top-level envelope.
Delegation depth/count and ancestry-cycle checks are pre-allocation enforcement, not advisory limits.
Capability is revalidated at use time immediately before the host adapter, so revocation between admission and execution fails closed.

protected_semantics.rule: indivisible; no security, migration, package, network, target or decode path may field-mix revisions
